_l10n:
HDrezka edition of the YouTube store-i18n@6 series. The SLIDES, layouts, crops and captures are YouTube's — only the ground colour and this copy differ. Three locales: en / ru / uk (the only ones HDrezka ships).

VOICE — the one thing that is not inherited. The YouTube series addresses the reader formally and capitalises sentences; the HDrezka series does not, and that difference is deliberate and pre-existing (see ../../promo-copy.json, the v1 deck): lowercase headlines, informal address (ru/uk «ты»/«ти», en contractions), and the subject is always a FILM or a SERIES, never 'a video'. Do not carry YouTube's register across while carrying its meaning.

WHAT EACH SLIDE MUST SAY (inherited from YouTube, do not re-scope):
  1  dual subtitles work on any title that has a subtitle track
  2  a word you save is marked everywhere it turns up again, and syncs to your account
  3  guess mode: catch the line by ear first, then reveal it
  4  the subtitles are yours to restyle — fonts, colour, size, position, backdrop
  5  the built-in dictionary

SLIDE 1 — NO MACHINE TRANSLATION ON HDREZKA. The YouTube line 'works on any video with subtitles' is safe there because YouTube auto-translates. HDrezka does not: the extension only ever shows subtitle tracks the title actually carries (store-description.en.md says so explicitly). Copy here must not imply a translation appears where the title has only one track.

SLIDE 5 — THE TWO STEPS ARE NOT THE SAME STEP. Hovering a word opens a small card: a part-of-speech tag and a few translations, nothing more. The FULL entry — every sense, the usage examples, the line the word appeared in — opens only when the reader presses the card's second button. Name that button with the locale's own ytLookupMore string from apps/rezka/_locales/<loc>/messages.json (ru «Разбор», uk «Розбір»), never a word you invent. Earlier YouTube copy said hovering showed the senses; it does not, and that wording was a bug, not a style.

NO CHARACTER BUDGET. The column is 440px: 'Cualquier palabra,' is 18 characters but 473px. Write the sentence first, break it second, then MEASURE and re-break what does not fit. Four lines are fine — the block has room below it.

The eyebrow is NOT auto-uppercased by CSS, so caps live here in the JSON.
